summary: Independent review of Jinshu 86 owned units s0630–s0841 (plus s0842) covering 耀靈, 祚, 玄靚, and 天錫. Chinese era anchors were read first. Year-only Western labels follow 穆帝永和十年 = AD 354, equated in-chapter with 建興四十二年/和平元年; 建興四十三年 = 355; 建興四十九年/奉升平 = 361; 興寧元年 = 363; 太和初 as onOrAfter 366; 太元元年 = 376; 淮肥 as 太元八年 = 383; 隆安中 = 397–401. These are conventional regnal-year labels, not month/day proleptic-Gregorian dates; Academia Sinica Julian/Gregorian switch is irrelevant here. Ages 十歲/年十四/十八九/年六十一 are preserved without birth-year conversion. Posthumous 賜諡, Heping 追崇, 故太尉 citation, 追贈, and the historian's appraisal stay retrospective and off the active-hint lists. Undated Lian Qi/Li Yan fighting and 立子大懷 correctly remain unresolved between 太和初 and 太元元年, refusing ZZTJ 367 / 晉記 368. Zuo's fall stays 354–355 with ZZTJ 永和十一年閏月 held as a competing witness. Tianxi's 尋卒 after 桓玄時 stays unresolved (no 義熙二年). One defect: p311 張瓘 is destroyed in s0713 共討瓘，盡夷其屬 with no death claim. p279 重華母馬氏 and p301 駿妻馬氏 are left as separate IDs; unmarked s0717 馬氏 is not identified. Split section IDs (祚 p287/p304, 天錫 p291/p306/p332, 軌 p271/p331/p364) are locally coherent.

references.reason: Confirms 穆帝永和 is AD 345–356, so the chapter's 永和十年 is the conventional AD 354 year label. Year-only; not a month/day Gregorian event date.

references.title: 建兴 (西晋)
references.quote: 永嘉七年（313年）四月二十七日，改元為建興元年。
references.reason: Confirms 愍帝建興元年 is AD 313, the count Former Liang continues. Combined with s0842+s0655, 建興四十二年 = 和平元年 = 永和十年 = AD 354.

references.title: 建兴 (西晋)
references.quote: 建興四十二年（354年）正月，張祚改元為和平元年。
references.reason: Agrees with Jinshu s0655 that 建興四十二年 was changed to 和平元年 in AD 354. Conventional year label.
